name: WordPress.com
where: Add a block (+), search “HTML”, choose Custom HTML, Edit HTML, paste, then Update.
limits: Scripts and frames only work on a paid plan with hosting features active; the free plan removes them when you save. If code disappears, re-enter it after activating hosting.

name: Wix
where: Add Elements → Embed Code → Embed HTML → Enter Code (or Embed a site → Enter Website Address), then Apply.
limits: Only HTTPS addresses show once published. Set width and height to 100% so the game is not cropped.

name: Squarespace
where: Code block (set the mode to HTML), or an Embed block with a code snippet.
limits: Code blocks need a Core, Plus or Advanced plan; Embed blocks are on all plans. Code can be hidden while you are logged in, so test in a private window.

name: Google Sites
where: Insert → Embed → Embed code, paste, Next, Insert, then Publish.
limits: JavaScript must sit inside script tags. You only see the result after publishing; desktop editor only.

name: Carrd
where: Embed element, Type: Code, Style: Inline.
limits: Needs Pro Standard or higher. Nothing shows in the builder; publish to see it.

name: Notion
where: Type /embed and paste the game address (the https://… link), not the code.
limits: Notion takes an address only: no script, no pasted frame code. Some addresses fail to load there, so add a normal link to the game page as a fallback.

name: Webflow
where: Code Embed element inside a container; paste the code and preview.
limits: Needs a paid site plan. Leave out html, body and head tags. Read from help-center snippets: check in your editor.

name: Ghost
where: HTML card in the post editor.
limits: The editor only shows a placeholder, so check the published page. Whether scripts run is not stated in the official page: check in your editor.

name: Shopify, Blogger, Weebly
where: Custom HTML or Liquid sections (Shopify), an HTML/JavaScript gadget (Blogger), an Embed Code element (Weebly).
limits: Steps and limits could not be confirmed from the official pages: check in your editor.
